body:
WHAT
When the measured or estimated context size reaches the effective auto-compact limit (a fraction of the connection's context window, optionally lowered by the UI), the engine sends the oldest part of the message history to a summarizer model call. The summary, wrapped in a system reminder, replaces those messages; the newest messages are kept whole (a tool_use is never split from its tool_result). The recorded context size is reset to a fresh estimate of the compacted window, never to zero.

WHY
Without compaction the request eventually exceeds the model's window and the session dies at the provider; resetting to zero would disarm the safety until the next response measured it.

WHERE
engine/core/src/runtime/session.ts — Session.maybeCompact(force) (threshold gate, isPromptDisabled(COMPACTION_SYSTEM) guard, splitIdx walk-back, replaces this.messages, transcript 'compaction' record, resets stats.contextTokens = estimateContextNow(), emits context_update and the 'Auto-compacted' note), Session.summarizeForCompaction() (chunked rolling summary), Session.runSummarizer() (uses settings.smallModel ?? settings.model with COMPACTION_SYSTEM), Session.summarizerBudget(), Session.effectiveCompactLimit()/derivedCompactLimit()/setAutoCompactLimit(); constants COMPACTION_SYSTEM, COMPACTION_WRAPPER. Called from runTurn after each tool round and at turn end, and from the context-overflow recovery path.

TEST CHECKLIST
1. With settings.contextWindow set so effectiveCompactLimit() is small and a FakeProvider that reports usage.inputTokens above that limit after a tool round, the next provider request receives a first user message containing 'Earlier conversation was compacted' plus the summarizer's scripted text, and the earliest original messages are gone.
2. The summarizer FakeProvider request uses the COMPACTION_SYSTEM text as its system prompt and, when settings.smallModel is set, that model id.
3. After compaction, session.stats.contextTokens is greater than 0 and equals the estimate (not 0), and a context_update event with that value is emitted.
4. The kept tail never opens with a tool_result-only message: with a history ending in tool_use/tool_result pairs, the message right after the summary is not a message containing tool_result blocks whose tool_use was summarized away.
5. maybeCompact(false) returns false and makes no provider request when the context is below the limit, or when effectiveCompactLimit() is 0 (auto-compaction switched off via setAutoCompactLimit(0)).
6. When the compaction.system prompt is disabled (empty in the registry), maybeCompact returns false, emits the '⚠ compaction is switched off' note and leaves this.messages unchanged.
